card.name: Historical texts before old dates
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces just before a year in the 1500s to 1800s, and small linking words in old historical or archaic recipe and military text.

modes.label: Before an old year
modes.description: The space or word right before a historical year such as 1859, 1788 or 1699.

modes.label: Old-style prose links
modes.description: A linking word or comma inside archaic or historical narrative, such as muskets or recipes.
modes.example: paper cartridges charged<< with>> powder, buck-shot and ball.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like modern and contemporary and away from words like early and imperial, a contrast between old and modern.
card.plain: It fires in history passages just before an old date, as if the text were about to place the event in time.
